name: arthurpower
description: Curated engineering constraints an agent can be held to: 23 skills, 13 PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook commands, 10 reviewer sub-agents, and 2 slash commands, with zero runtime dependencies. Five of the six S1-S6 governance rules ship a dedicated skill with numeric gates; S4 is graded inside code-review's Spec axis. S5 additionally ships a standalone ESLint-based complexity runner for TypeScript/JavaScript projects.
